text:
ana: quick heads-up — after landing the selector heuristic for attention, canary cluster shows a p99 spike on long-context workloads.

ana: smoke run snapshot:
```
smokebench --model=redwood-7b --seq=2048 --clients=48 --duration=600
metrics: p50=10.3ms p90=22.4ms p99=48.9ms p999=110ms
notes: tail has intermittent 40-150ms stalls, not sustained throughput drop
```

kai: thanks. do logs show selector decisions right before stalls? any "switch_to_generic" lines?

ana: yes — finder lines show `selector: pick=fused_attn_v2 alt=generic_attn reason=predicted_win` then immediately `failover=generic_attn reason=kv_layout_mismatch`. looks like cost model overconfident.

mira: microbench changes increased weight for fused on >1k tokens, but that was single-seq perf. we didn't test prefix+generate mixes. selector assumes stable cache layout per-request.

jordan: plausible. if the selector changes mid-request that causes extra memcpy / kernel init, p99 will blow up. can we prevent mid-request switching?

seb: also want per-kernel latency histograms — current telemetry aggregates across kernels. we need kernel_name tags + p50/p90/p99 per kernel for a short period.

ana: proposed triage actions:
- revert canary rollout on cluster-d (mira)
- add harness that mimics prefix-heavy traffic (70% prefix, 30% generation) and run bisect on selector coeffs (kai)
- emit per-kernel histograms + selector_decision tags for 2h in canary (jordan)
- add a smokebench regression test that asserts bootstrap CI for p99 (ana)

mira: doing immediate rollback. pinging deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: rollback started for cluster-d:kernel-selector-canary -> status: in_progress

deploy-bot: rollback complete -> status: success :white_check_mark:

kai: for bisect i'll prepare 8 coefficient vectors. i'll run N=2000 samples each so we can estimate p99 CI via bootstrap. suggest using 1000 bootstrap draws.

ana: agree. also compute KS-test between baseline and candidate latency distributions to catch shape changes, not just percentile deltas.

jordan: i'll add telemetry fields: kernel_name, selector_choice, request_phase (prefix/generation). enable on canary only to limit card. will include a lightweight flame trace when fallback occurs.

seb: verification checklist:
- deterministic harness seed
- prefix/generation mix configurable
- capture KV-cache hit/miss counts per request
- per-kernel latency histogram export
- bootstrap CI + KS p-value for distribution shift

mira: if a single coeff set is causing regressions, do we prefer to hard-fail selection when confidence low, or tune coefficients?

kai: prefer safety first: clamp switching rate, disallow selector flips mid-request, then refine cost model based on harness results.

ana: i'm opening infra/eng-runtime#1012 with microbench-vs-harness notes and linking here. will add smokebench scenario details.

mira: thanks — owners: mira=rollback(done), kai=bisect+PR, jordan=telemetry patch, seb=verify harness, ana=smokebench regression + issue. i'll check back in ~24h. :thumbsup:

ana: will post test results and raw histograms once runs finish.

jordan: adding a small helper to aggregate fallback traces: `tools/trace_agg --tag selector_decision --since 2h`

seb: if we see kernel launch jitter even without fallback, that's a separate path — maybe driver/kernel warmup. include GPU-side queue depth metrics.

ana: noted. thanks everyone.

mira: :rocket:
